findings.title: Apply-concurrency test never observes concurrent execution
findings.detail: At crates/blit-core/tests/local_session.rs:1595, the new guard checks the configured worker accessor and final tree equality but never measures concurrent in-flight work. Forcing the production wiring at crates/blit-core/src/transfer_session/local.rs:781 back to one worker left the intended test green; the exact bytes were restored and the test remained green. Thus the performance capability can regress silently. Add an injected sink or pipeline probe that blocks workers and asserts peak concurrency exceeds one through run_local_session.
